answer: Fail cover pool: each address pays 2% of every reward into a pool. If an appeal panel of 7 overturns a fail with 5 votes, the pool refunds 50% of the lost reward. Each refund claim is a thread, and claims from one funder cluster form a marble of correlated losses, so that cluster's premium rises tenfold to 20%. A farm gaming appeals pays 20% on every reward but recovers at most half of the rare fail it overturns, so overturn farming loses money. Bypass: spread claims over 20 funders. Check rule: recompute each funder's claim rate from the ledger; a dune of identical rates flags the split.
